'''Jason Haskell''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 3rd in [[DecipherCon 1999 Allegiances]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw10_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Allegiances Multi Deck Format], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000525035447/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>.
